title: Eastern-Style Oven-Baked Turkey Neck
description: A hearty and comforting oven-baked meal from the Middle East, featuring tender turkey neck and crispy falafel.

ingredients.name: Turkey neck
ingredients.notes: ask your butcher for a cleaned and patted dry neck

instructions: Season the turkey neck with salt and black pepper.
In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the turkey neck until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and falafel to the pot.
Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the neck is cooked through and the falafel is crispy.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the neck and falafel.
Serve with bake potatoes and your favorite sides.
Let the dish rest for 5-10 minutes before serving.
